_about: Cards Japan has released and the English card list has not. Each new card's text is an unofficial translation of the Japanese card, marked as such on the card. Reprints carry the English card's own text. Remove a set once the English card list has it: the refresh then brings it in with official text.

cards.name: Road to the Live, Lubna
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) by riding from a unit with "Santi" in its card name, draw a card.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater with "Lubna" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of that battle, and at the end of that battle, put this unit into soul.
[AUTO](Soul):When your vanguard with "Lubna" in its card name is attacked, [COST][put this card on the bottom of your deck], and that unit gets [Power]+10000 until end of that battle. You cannot pay the costs of [AUTO] abilities in your soul of cards with the same name as this card for that turn.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]

cards.name: Days of Lessons, Santi
cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is ridden by "Road to the Live, Lubna", choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it. If you did not retire, draw a card.
[ACT](Soul/Drop):If your vanguard is grade 3 with "Lubna" in its card name, and you have not ridden this turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & bind this card], search your deck for up to one grade 3 or greater card with "Lubna" in its card name, ride it as [Stand], and shuffle your deck.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]

cards.effect:
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC) or (RC), if your vanguard has "Lubna" in its card name, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and perform one of the following. If this unit was placed on (VC), you do not need to pay the cost.
・Choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it.
・If it is not your battle phase, look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to one card with grade less than or equal to your vanguard's grade from among them, call it to (RC), and shuffle your deck.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, if your vanguard is [D-Legion], all of your front row rear-guards get [Power]+5000 until end of turn. Then, if this is the second battle this unit has performed this turn, [COST][Energy-Blast 3], choose a card from your hand, call it to a front row (RC), and it gets [Power]+10000 until end of turn. If this unit [D-Legion] this turn, choose one of your units in the same column as the called unit, and [Stand] it.
[CONT](RC):If your vanguard is grade 3 or greater with "Lubna" in its card name, this unit gets [Power]+5000.
[Unofficial translation of the Japanese card. The English DZ-SS19 is due 2027-01-22.]
